title: Apple Joins Nvidia in $5 Trillion Market Cap Club
source_used: Yahoo Finance (relaying The Wall Street Journal)
key_facts: Apple closed above a $5 trillion market value for the first time on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026.
Shares rose 0.5% to a record close of $342.96, a value of about $5.005 trillion.
Nvidia is the only other company to have closed above $5 trillion, at roughly $5.3 trillion.
The Nasdaq Composite fell nearly 1.9% the same day.
Tim Cook stepped down on 1 Sept and handed the job to John Ternus.
Apple has lagged some rivals in advanced AI models and works with Google to improve Siri.
Apple's next earnings report is scheduled for 2 Nov.
quote_evidence: Apple closed above a $5 trillion market valuation for the first time Wednesday, becoming only the second publicly traded company to reach the milestone as investors weigh the technology giant's next phase under CEO John Ternus.
Apple has lagged behind some rivals in developing advanced AI models, prompting the company to pursue outside partnerships, including work with Google to improve Siri.
why_it_matters_hint: Apple's value hit a record even as the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell.
